name: Type 1 Diabetes
description: Autoimmune disease characterized by T cell-mediated destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β cells in the islets of Langerhans, leading to absolute insulin deficiency and lifelong dependence on exogenous insulin. Distinguished from Type 2 Diabetes by the presence of islet autoantibodies.
prevalence: ~1.6 million US (~0.5% prevalence); incidence rising 3-4% annually
peak_onset: Childhood/adolescence (peak 4-14 years); can occur at any age (LADA)
